# Vendor Onboarding Policy

## High Risk Requirements

High-risk vendors require W-9 receipt, clear sanctions screening, a SOC 2 Type II
report dated within the last 12 months, cyber liability coverage of at least
$2,000,000, and a signed Data Processing Addendum before launch.

## Bank Change Controls

Bank-account changes require callback verification using a known contact and AP
manager approval before the first payment to the new account.

## Security Exception Review

If a high-risk vendor processes payroll data or bank-account tokens and cannot
support customer-managed encryption keys, Security Director approval is required
before production launch.
